why: Leaf 0 (no attack): passive, gives opponent time to stabilize with creatures next turn. Leaf 1 (attack): establishes clock/pressure with 1 damage, races them down. Opponent has no creatures yet, so tapping my Ape is safe now. Even if they remove it with Go for the Throat, it's a fair 1-for-1 trade. Aggro wins by racing; attacking is correct.
